features.title: Digital Delivery Tickets
features.body: Eliminate lost paper tickets and manual data entry. Capture digital signatures, take photos of delivered materials, and automatically sync quantities to your inventory ledger.

features.title: Automated Reordering
features.body: Set custom minimum thresholds for every material on every site. When stock dips below your par level, SiteFlow automatically drafts a purchase order for your preferred vendor.

faqs.q: Does SiteFlow integrate with accounting and ERP tools?
faqs.a: Yes. SiteFlow exports vendor bills, payments, and inventory valuations to Tally Prime as importable voucher XML, and pushes data to Zoho Books, Google Sheets, and Google Drive through encrypted OAuth integrations. A REST API is available for custom links.

faqs.q: How does the mobile app handle offline connectivity at remote sites?
faqs.a: The SiteFlow mobile app (iOS and Android) works offline. Field teams can receive deliveries, capture photos, and update inventory without a signal. Everything syncs to the cloud automatically once a cellular or Wi-Fi connection returns.

faqs.q: Can suppliers see our purchase orders?
faqs.a: Yes. Through the supplier-facing flow, vendors can acknowledge purchase orders, update estimated delivery dates, and submit invoices against the original order so your team always sees live status.
